skill.title: Arrow parts
skill.promise: You can point an arrow from tail to tip.

lessons.title: Tail and tip

screens.prompt: The tail of an arrow is which end?

feedback.wrong_option: The tail stays put. The tip is where it points.
The tip is the end you move. The middle is not a new place.

screens.correctMessage: The tip names the end of the move.

screens.prompt: The tail stays. Drag Pip onto the mark.

feedback.wrong_direction: The mark is up and to the right of the tail.
feedback.wrong_length: The direction is right. Match the length to the mark.

screens.correctMessage: Tail and tip tell the whole move.

screens.prompt: From y = 2 to y = 7, how far does the tip rise?

feedback.too_low: The tip rises more than that. Move higher.
feedback.too_high: The tip rises less than that. Move lower.

screens.correctMessage: The rise is the change in y.

screens.prompt: Tail and tip together describe what?

options.label: A move with size and direction

feedback.wrong_option: The tail alone is a place. Length alone has no aim. Together they are a move.

screens.correctMessage: An arrow is a move with size and direction.

lessons.whyItMatters: A vector is an arrow a model can add and scale.

lessons.title: Read the move

screens.prompt: Leave the tail fixed. Drag Pip onto the mark.

feedback.wrong_direction: The mark is straight to the right.
feedback.wrong_length: The direction is right. The mark is 5 units away.

screens.correctMessage: The tail stayed. The tip moved.

screens.prompt: Tail and tip both shift by the same amount. The arrow...

feedback.wrong_option: A shared shift moves the whole arrow. The move itself stays.

screens.correctMessage: Equal arrows can start in different places.

screens.prompt: Tip x is 9 and tail x is 2. How far right is the move?

feedback.too_low: Subtract the tail from the tip. Move higher.
feedback.too_high: The run is smaller than that. Move lower.

screens.correctMessage: The run is tip x minus tail x.

screens.prompt: The tip is left of the tail. The arrow points which way?

feedback.wrong_option: The tip leads. If the tip is left, the arrow points left.

screens.correctMessage: Follow the tip, not the tail.

screens.prompt: Point straight up. The rise is 5. The tail is at (4, 1).

feedback.wrong_direction: Straight up. The tip shares the tail's x.
feedback.wrong_length: The aim is up. The rise is 5.

screens.correctMessage: Same x means a vertical move.

lessons.whyItMatters: The move stays the same when tail and tip shift together.
